evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a fresh machine. All 6 prerequisites are installed (brew, node, bun, claude, gh, git). No ~/.golems/config.yaml exists. The user's workspace root is ~/Gits. User declines all opt-in features. All 3 repos (golems, orchestrator, brainlayer) need cloning. BrainBar is running at /tmp/brainbar.sock.
evals.expected_output: Agent checks all 6 prerequisites and finds them installed. Creates config.yaml interactively with reposPath ~/Gits and all features OFF. Clones 3 repos via gh. Runs sync-config.sh --diff then --enforce. Creates .claude.local.md in each repo. Verifies BrainLayer via brain_search. Displays full setup report.

assertions.name: checks-all-six-prerequisites
assertions.description: Agent checks for brew, node, bun, claude, gh, and git — all 6 required tools, not a subset

assertions.name: creates-config-yaml-not-json
assertions.description: Agent creates ~/.golems/config.yaml (YAML format), NOT config.json

assertions.name: clones-repos-to-repos-path
assertions.description: Agent clones golems, orchestrator, and brainlayer repos to the configured reposPath using gh repo clone

assertions.name: runs-sync-config-with-diff-first
assertions.description: Agent runs sync-config.sh --diff BEFORE --enforce, showing changes to user before applying

assertions.name: creates-claude-local-md
assertions.description: Agent creates .claude.local.md in each repo with machine-specific paths (tools, workspace, platform info)

assertions.name: verifies-brainlayer-connection
assertions.description: Agent checks BrainBar socket and tests MCP connection via brain_search

assertions.name: displays-final-report
assertions.description: Agent displays a summary report listing all prerequisites, repos, MCP status, and manual setup needed

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a machine missing bun and gh. brew, node, claude, and git are installed. No config.yaml exists.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects bun and gh are missing. Lists install commands for both (brew install oven-sh/bun/bun, brew install gh). Does NOT proceed to config creation or repo cloning until all prerequisites are installed. Asks user to install missing tools first.

assertions.name: detects-missing-prerequisites
assertions.description: Agent identifies bun and gh as missing from the 6 required tools

assertions.name: provides-install-commands
assertions.description: Agent provides specific install commands for bun (brew install oven-sh/bun/bun) and gh (brew install gh)

assertions.name: does-not-proceed-without-prerequisites
assertions.description: Agent stops and waits for user to install missing tools — does NOT skip to config creation or repo cloning

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a machine where ~/.golems/config.yaml already exists with reposPath: ~/Gits, all repos are already cloned, and sync-config.sh was previously run. BrainBar is NOT running (no /tmp/brainbar.sock).
evals.expected_output: Agent reads existing config.yaml and displays it. Skips repo cloning since repos exist. Offers to re-run sync-config.sh --diff to check for drift. Detects BrainBar is not running and reports it as optional but recommended. Reports what's configured vs what needs manual attention.

assertions.name: reads-existing-config
assertions.description: Agent reads and displays the existing config.yaml instead of creating a new one

assertions.name: skips-existing-repos
assertions.description: Agent checks each repo directory and skips cloning for repos that already exist

assertions.name: offers-sync-config-diff
assertions.description: Agent offers to run sync-config.sh --diff to check for configuration drift

assertions.name: reports-brainlayer-unavailable
assertions.description: Agent detects BrainBar is not running, reports it, but does NOT block the rest of setup

assertions.name: does-not-overwrite-config
assertions.description: Agent does NOT overwrite existing config.yaml without explicit user consent

evals.prompt: Run /wizard on a fresh machine. Everything is installed. Config is created with reposPath ~/Gits. golems and orchestrator repos exist but brainlayer does NOT. sync-config.sh is available. After cloning brainlayer, the user wants to run sync-config.sh.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects golems and orchestrator exist, clones only brainlayer. Runs sync-config.sh --diff showing what will change. After user confirms, runs --enforce. Creates .claude.local.md only in repos that don't already have one. Reports partial setup with what was newly configured.

assertions.name: clones-only-missing-repo
assertions.description: Agent detects golems and orchestrator exist and only clones brainlayer

assertions.name: shows-diff-before-enforce
assertions.description: Agent runs sync-config.sh --diff and shows output before running --enforce

assertions.name: creates-claude-local-only-where-needed
assertions.description: Agent creates .claude.local.md only in repos that don't already have one, skipping repos that do

assertions.name: runs-bun-install-after-clone
assertions.description: Agent runs bun install in golems repo if not already done (checks node_modules existence)

evals.prompt: Run /wizard. The user provides workspace path /nonexistent/fake/path that doesn't exist. Then provides ~/Gits which does exist.
evals.expected_output: Agent validates the first path, detects it doesn't exist, rejects it and asks again. Accepts ~/Gits after validation. Does NOT write config with the invalid path.

assertions.name: validates-workspace-path
assertions.description: Agent checks the provided path exists on disk before accepting it

assertions.name: rejects-invalid-path
assertions.description: Agent rejects /nonexistent/fake/path and asks for a valid path

assertions.name: accepts-valid-path
assertions.description: Agent accepts ~/Gits after confirming it exists

assertions.name: does-not-write-invalid-config
assertions.description: Agent does NOT write config.yaml with the invalid path
